research_gaps: High computational/memory cost of Vision‑Transformer and hybrid CNN‑ViT backbones limits real‑time deployment on edge devices.

Domain adaptation is still fragile; existing fine‑tuning or style‑transfer methods cannot fully close the gap for extreme illumination changes, synthetic‑real texture shifts, and night‑day transitions.
Persistent loss of fine‑grained detail on thin, distant, specular or transparent objects, especially when using lightweight or real‑time models.

proposals.name: Efficient Sparse‑Attention ViT with Dynamic Token Pruning (ESA‑ViT)
proposals.rationale: Replace dense self‑attention with a hierarchical sparse‑attention scheme that prunes low‑information tokens early, and incorporate a lightweight CNN stem for early‑level geometry cues.
proposals.expected_benefit: Near‑Transformer accuracy on global context while reducing FLOPs × 4–6 and memory × 3, enabling >30 fps on a 2023‑class mobile GPU.
proposals.risk: Token pruning may discard subtle cues needed for thin structures, requiring careful scheduling and retraining.

proposals.name: Self‑Supervised Domain‑Invariant Feature Normalization (DIS‑Norm)
proposals.rationale: Introduce a dual‑branch normalization that aligns feature statistics across source and target domains using an unsupervised contrastive loss on synthetic‑real and day‑night image pairs, without explicit style‑transfer GANs.
proposals.expected_benefit: Improves zero‑shot cross‑domain depth error by ~12 % on night‑time and synthetic‑real benchmarks, with negligible extra parameters and no per‑target fine‑tuning.
proposals.risk: Requires a modest amount of unlabelled target images for the contrastive pairing; performance may degrade if domain shift is extreme (e.g., underwater).

proposals.name: Edge‑Guided Multi‑Scale Diffusion Refinement (EG‑DiffRefine)
proposals.rationale: Apply a lightweight diffusion module only on edge‑aware regions detected by a fast gradient mask; the diffusion operates on low‑resolution patches and upscales via guided interpolation, preserving high‑frequency depth at critical structures.
proposals.expected_benefit: Recovers sharp depth edges on thin/reflective objects while adding <8 ms latency on 1080p inputs, achieving a 20 % reduction in edge RMSE compared to baseline real‑time models.
proposals.risk: Edge detection may miss low‑contrast thin structures; the extra module introduces implementation complexity and can be sensitive to mask thresholds.

recommended_option: Efficient Sparse‑Attention ViT with Dynamic Token Pruning (ESA‑ViT)
